question.text: Under the present SEBI bonus-issue framework, when does trading in bonus shares commence relative to the record date (T Day)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the present SEBI framework, the record date is T Day, deemed allotment of bonus shares happens on T+1, and bonus shares become available for trading on T+2. Temporary ISINs are exempted in favour of direct credit into the permanent ISIN. The Trap: T+1, T+3 working days, and T+5 working days reflect older or unrelated timelines and miss both the T+2 trading start and the permanent-ISIN credit. Note: The compressed bonus timeline avoids temporary ISINs entirely — bonus shares are credited directly to the existing permanent ISIN, which is what enables T+2 trading.
